Live Wedding Music Tailored to You

Serenade Strings creates the perfect musical backdrop for weddings, civil ceremonies, receptions, and private events. Our repertoire covers everything from Bridgerton-style classical to chart hits, and we love arranging special requests to make your day unique.

Based in Cardiff and London, we perform at stunning venues throughout the South West, Wales, and beyond—including Bristol, Somerset, and the Cotswolds. Every booking is personal, and we’re trusted by couples and venues for our reliability, quality, and friendly approach.
